parameters.excerpt: For each bit in 61:58, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses which privilege modes are implemented, which determines whether the corresponding INH bits in mcyclecfg/minstretcfg are read-only zero or read-write. This controls the RO/RW nature of specific CSR fields.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: mcyclecfg and minstretcfg are 64-bit registers that configure privilege mode filtering for the cycle and instret counters, respectively.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: When all xINH bits are zero, event counting is enabled in all modes.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: The cycle counter will simply count CPU cycles while the CPU is in a non-inhibited privilege mode.
skipped_non_parameters.reason: This describes the required behavior of the counter based on CSR configuration, not an implementation choice.

skipped_non_parameters.excerpt: instructions that retire in a non-inhibited mode increment instret, and instructions that retire in an inhibited mode do not.
